children: Baltic real estate developer's Q3 revenue was broadly flat yr/yr at EUR 5.6 mln
Company posted Q3 net loss of EUR 1.3 mln, versus EUR 0.2 mln loss a year earlier
Gross margin fell to 25% from 30% due to lower sales volumes, shift to lower-margin projects
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods in its press release
SALES MIX SHIFT - Co said a shift in sales mix toward lower-margin projects contributed to reduced gross margin in Q3
LOWER SALES VOLUMES - Co said slightly lower sales volumes contributed to weaker Q3 gross margin
HIGHER EXPENSES - Co cited higher marketing and administrative expenses as factors weighing on profitability
